comment: The registry is said to contain only stable core attributes, but the examples later include storage requirements, shelf life, regulatory details, origin, and volumetrics, which can change by item, packaging level, market, and manufacturer.

anchor.note: p.145 l.Lines 388-392 read as the printed page; section 1 agrees

public.text: The registry is said to contain only stable core attributes, but the examples later include storage requirements, shelf life, regulatory details, origin, and volumetrics, which can change by item, packaging level, market, and manufacturer.
public.suggestedRevision: Separate stable product identity from versioned item, packaging, regulatory, and logistics attributes. Define update authority and lifecycle for each category.
